about: D-SINK-105 (2026-11-16): the code points every helper reply, both status files (playlist-status.json, epg-status.json) and every IPC reply of the shell (Model.ipcJson) write as a JSON escape: DEL and the C1 controls, the line and paragraph separators, and the twelve text-direction controls (Unicode's Bidi_Control set). Inside a JSON string only, so every parser reads the same value. tests/test_reply_shown.py puts one string of every code point but the surrogates through the helper's emit and write_status (REPLY_ESCAPE_RANGES), and tests/Model.test.js through Model.ipcJson; each asserts every code point here is escaped and every other one printable is written as it is. `notEscaped` are format characters left alone on purpose: escaping a zero-width joiner would break an emoji.
